Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.core

Class TelemetryRecorder

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.core.TelemetryRecorder
public class TelemetryRecorder extends Object
Receives the work from the commands and publishes the resulting events to the hub. It is the receiver in the Command pattern.
Author:
Haeley Parbhoo
